question: Chandernagore (Chandannagar), located on the banks of the Hooghly River, was a major trading center established by which European power in Bengal?
explanation: Chandernagore was established as a French colony in 1673, when the French obtained permission from Ibrahim Khan, the Nawab of Bengal, to set up a trading post there.

question: Who was the French administrator who served as the Governor of Chandernagore from 1731 to 1741 and transformed it into the main commercial rival of British Calcutta?
explanation: Joseph François Dupleix was appointed Governor of Chandernagore in 1731. Under his energetic administration, the city became a highly prosperous commercial hub in Bengal, rivaling British Calcutta in trade volume.
